author: MIT OpenCourseWare
description:
Professor Nancy Kanwisher explores the limits of human attention and cognition through the “toaster model” of mental processing and explains how the brain processes different types of information in parallel.

View the full lecture: https://youtu.be/B4a0WdGp52g?si=IX5KGOjXpESM9l9l
View the class: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUl4u3cNGP60IKRN_pFptIBxeiMc0MCJP&si=JFI5UQt7lyenEG_g
title: Is multitasking a myth?
